data.name: VINDICTA
data.detailed_description:
Behind the gates of their massive HN1 Facility, UB Industries reveals itself to be the evil corporation it really is, building a robot army in its evil plans to take over the world. But hope is all but lost in this world - as an elite infantry agent, Agent V, your mission is simple: infiltrate the fortified facility, seek and destroy evil robots and put an end to UB Industries operations once and for all!

VINDICTA, a shooting game with a strong stealth component, will you make you feel as immersed as ever as you find your way around UB Industries, shooting robots, ducking to avoid their incoming bullets and hiding to escape enemy fire! Discover a whole new level of VR action gaming and feel your heart racing as you pick up deadly weapons of all grades to fight off evil robots out to take you down!

vindicta Features:


Active VR Gameplay: Feel the adrenaline rush as you physically walk through UB Industries' facility, ducking to dodge laser beams, taking cover during shootouts with evil robots and launching cluster grenades at incoming attackers!

Locmotion System: VINDICTA has two main locomotion system to choose from: the main arm-swinging locomotion which feels very natural inside a VR environment and a very smooth and responsive trackpad movement option. The choice is yours!

Precision Shooting: Shooting mechanic is on point! VINDICTA takes realism to a whole new level with a focus on stealth, tactical movement, and precision shooting.

Deadly Weapons: Handguns, rifles and cluster grenades are just some of the massive weapons you'll be using to take down your enemies.

A Variety of Enemies: Shoot and destroy enemies that will come at you from different directions, in all shapes and sizes - including drones, mechanical spiders among others so watch out!

Scoring System: Different shots mean different scores! The scoring system is just the thing to add to the game its competitive edge!

Only one can take the top spot on the VINDICTA leaderboard and be the ultimate Agent V! You’ve got to ask yourself one question… do you have what it takes?

data.short_description: Experience the thrill of VR action gaming in VINDICTA, a first person shooter game built from the ground-up for VR! Feel part of the action as you dive into VINDICTA, climbing and crawling your way through, picking up weapons, taking cover and shooting your way to the next levels!

reviews.review:
[h1]Vindicta - [i]Infiltrate an enemy stronghold with stealth..then blast everything in this fun vr shooter![/i][/h1]
 
It is your standard premise for an fps game, here are some bad guys, we do not know what they are up to so we shall sneak you in, once in you very quickly find a gun and set about ensuring that no one lives to tell of your infiltration, ah my kind of stealth as anyone who has seen my old lets plays will atest to, has to be stealth if there is no one left that can remember you! 
At the start of the game there are some really well made, lovable and non hostile robot scientists…. I would like to say that no innocent robotic scientists were harmed for this review….i would...i really would...but it would be a bold faced lie (Don’t judge me, their worth 10 points!) I did adopt one of these though, he looked sad and i could not bring myself to shoot him, i have named him George. So what does that last paragraph tell you? Probably that i am a psychopathic robot killer, but it should also tell you that i really liked the assets used for the scientists and that one robot with his little idle animation in itself was really impressive, i hope with time they add more little touches to the animations like that!
The game itself plays as a really well done shooter, the evil organisation the robots work for has really skimped on the projectile weapon budget and as such the enemy guns fire very slow moving bullets which allow you to dodge them feeling like neo dodging bullets in the matrix, this feels very very satisfying.
There is also a scoring system in place ensuring replayability for those of us that love leaderboards and getting the most headshots. The pistol in this game (though range limited grrr) is very very accurate, love that gun.
 
[b]ROOMSCALE / ENVIRONMENT / GRAPHICS[/b]
 While the game will not win awards for the best ever graphics they have created some really nice assets, from the aforementioned scientists to spider robots, i really like the aesthetics of the game. The level design also meant that i did not get lost at any point while still feeling quite open. Though on one level it did require me to crawl under fans of death (can we get the health and safety rep in here? Oh...he died..massive spinning blades in a sewer ah) I am not a huge fan of being forced to crawl, but that is a personal preference. 
All in all the graphics are perfect for the game, the enemies are well done (and i am sure more animations and tweaks will happen as time passes)
 
[b]PERFORMANCE[/b] 
No issues performance wise, i did have a few minor bugs but they were addressed by the devs fairly quickly and this was during the alpha - when such bugs are not only expected but actively seeked out. 
 
[b]INTUITIVENESS[/b] 
There is (as you will see in the video below) a short but good tutorial, they also support two different (three sort of) locomotion styles, the one where you swing your arms about like a loon that is so favoured for some weird reason by many vr players, and a touch pad movement system, the latter is my prefered movement system and works really well.
You have two places you can “clip” guns to, and the guns all work in your standard expected way, my only real complaint with the game is that only the pistol has a decent iron sight. The level design as i have said further up is also well done to ensure you do not get confused or lost, and even the climbing mechanic is intuitive, this is a well made game.
 
[b]PROS:[/b] 
[list]
[*] Keen, good developers that care about the game and listen to feedback.  
[*] Good accurate guns (ok mainly the pistol)
[*] A score system and leaderboards.
[*] Two different locomotion systems allowing you to take your pick
[*] Good atmosphere and level design.
[*] A variety of enemy types.
[/list]
 
[b]CONS:[/b] 
[list]
[*] Only the pistol has a decent iron sight.
[*] A little higher priced then i would of expected. 
[/list]
 
[b]Video of 1st Level and Tutorial[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cRqyItQbr7U
 
[b]VERDICT[/b] 
This is a very fun game to play, if the high cost does not put you off i fully recommend getting it, if not wish list it for the sales.The combination of accurate gunplay and semi bullet time makes for a really enjoyable experience and the developers clearly love their creation and are likely to expand and improve it even more.
